messages:
elaine: Quick design check — routing policies editor. Focus areas: preview panel visuals, priority ordering affordance, and validation copy. Attached Figma: https://figma.com/s/abc123 (proto)

mike: Saw the comps. Main concern: the reorder handle is tiny on small screens. Feels fiddly. Can we add a larger drag affordance + a visible grip icon? Also hit target should be ~40px.

sam: Agreed on handle. For validation copy: prefer actionable, specific messaging. e.g. `Conflicting routing rules — Rule 3 overlaps Rule 1. Increase priority or refine condition.` Inline hint under the rule > global toast.

nayan: Preview simulation: when users toggle model variants we should show which variant is being used in the preview header (small badge). Also allow a step-through mode (simulate a single request path) so we can show which rule matched.

elaine: Good notes. Thinking copy options:
- Title: "Conflicting routing rules"
- Body: "This rule overlaps with higher-priority rules. Click to highlight the overlap and choose a resolution."
Would that satisfy clarity + actionability?

mike: That reads well. Accessibility nit: don’t rely on color alone for conflict state. Add an icon and text label. Also keyboard users need a focusable reorder control (aria-label) and visible focus ring.

ux-bot: lint-warning: prototype missing `aria-label` on drag-handle. Missing contrast on conflict badge at 12px text.

sam: Copy tweak: for preview simulation CTA use `Run sample through policy` instead of `Simulate` — more explicit for non-technical PMs. And in the preview details show a small `cost / latency` row per matched rule so product teams can see tradeoffs.

nayan: Yes to cost/latency. Also show a breadcrumb of which fallback happened when a higher-priority rule was skipped (helps debugging).

elaine: Plan of action — I'll iterate tonight:
1) Increase drag handle hit target + add grip icon + aria-label
2) Change validation copy to the actionable text above and show inline hint under affected rule
3) Add variant badge in preview header and `Run sample through policy` CTA
4) Add a compact `cost / latency` row and a fallback breadcrumb in preview

mike: :thumbsup: thanks. If you want, I can mock the keyboard flow for reorder tomorrow morning.

sam: One more UX nit — when a rule is disabled we greys it, but the preview still shows it as active in the timeline. Make sure disabled rules are excluded from simulation unless user toggles `include disabled`.

elaine: Good catch. Will exclude disabled by default and add an `Include disabled rules` toggle in the preview toolbar.

nayan: Perfect. Small ask: make the preview results permalinkable (so SRE/product can link to a sample run in bug reports).

elaine: Noted — adding permalink to the list. I'll upload updated frames to the Figma link and ping here when done.

mike: :raised_hands:

ux-bot: design update checklist created: aria labels, copy changes, preview badges, keyboard reorder, cost row, permalink. Assigned: elaine.
